assessments.title: Business strategy and value hypotheses: A Multi-Branch Repair Network (Sponsored View, Week 1)
assessments.description: Sponsored View assessment applying business strategy and value hypotheses to a hypothetical business case involving a multi-branch repair network and a neighborhood repair cooperative. Learners consider how to triage service requests, state assumptions, and identify relevant evidence and safeguards; no business result is presumed.
learning_objectives: Translate an objective into a bounded AI use-case hypothesis.
Compare AI assistance with process redesign and other alternatives.
Specify an accountable owner, assumptions, and decision evidence.

questions.prompt: A multi-branch repair network is considering how to triage service requests in its work involving a neighborhood repair cooperative. Some requests lack context, so staff currently ask clarifying questions. What should a sponsor define before selecting a product?
options: The business outcome, affected user, and work to change
Draft suggestions may reduce sorting effort if staff can verify them accurately
A documented current workflow and relevant outcome measures
Compare AI assistance with process and conventional-tool alternatives
questions.correct_answer: The business outcome, affected user, and work to change
questions.rationale: A use case starts from an organizational need and the people and workflow involved; a product choice alone does not establish strategic fit. Apply this principle to business strategy and value hypotheses in the stated case; the scenario provides no basis to assume an unobserved outcome.

questions.prompt: A multi-branch repair network is considering how to triage service requests in its work involving a neighborhood repair cooperative. Some requests lack context, so staff currently ask clarifying questions. Which is a testable value hypothesis?
options: A baseline comparison that includes review work and quality
Draft suggestions may reduce sorting effort if staff can verify them accurately
A bounded queue with staff checking suggestions and a review route
A named business owner accountable for workflow outcomes
questions.correct_answer: Draft suggestions may reduce sorting effort if staff can verify them accurately
questions.rationale: A hypothesis names a mechanism and a condition to test rather than promising an outcome before evidence exists. Apply this principle to business strategy and value hypotheses in the stated case; the scenario provides no basis to assume an unobserved outcome.

questions.prompt: A multi-branch repair network is considering how to triage service requests in its work involving a neighborhood repair cooperative. Some requests lack context, so staff currently ask clarifying questions. What is a useful baseline?
options: Staff can review suggestions in the actual workflow
Expand only if evidence, safeguards, and readiness are adequate
A documented current workflow and relevant outcome measures
Use the simpler intervention if it meets the objective
questions.correct_answer: A documented current workflow and relevant outcome measures
questions.rationale: A baseline makes comparison possible and describes current work rather than importing claims from elsewhere. Apply this principle to business strategy and value hypotheses in the stated case; the scenario provides no basis to assume an unobserved outcome.

questions.prompt: A multi-branch repair network is considering how to triage service requests in its work involving a neighborhood repair cooperative. Some requests lack context, so staff currently ask clarifying questions. How should the team decide whether AI is needed?
options: The business outcome, affected user, and work to change
Draft suggestions may reduce sorting effort if staff can verify them accurately
A documented current workflow and relevant outcome measures
Compare AI assistance with process and conventional-tool alternatives
questions.correct_answer: Compare AI assistance with process and conventional-tool alternatives
questions.rationale: A strategic choice compares plausible ways to reach the objective; AI is not automatically the best fit. Apply this principle to business strategy and value hypotheses in the stated case; the scenario provides no basis to assume an unobserved outcome.

questions.prompt: A multi-branch repair network is considering how to triage service requests in its work involving a neighborhood repair cooperative. Some requests lack context, so staff currently ask clarifying questions. Which pilot scope supports a responsible early test?
options: A bounded queue with staff checking suggestions and a review route
Compare AI assistance with process and conventional-tool alternatives
A named business owner accountable for workflow outcomes
A baseline comparison that includes review work and quality
questions.correct_answer: A bounded queue with staff checking suggestions and a review route
questions.rationale: A limited, reviewable test can reveal value and failure modes without prematurely transferring authority. Apply this principle to business strategy and value hypotheses in the stated case; the scenario provides no basis to assume an unobserved outcome.

questions.prompt: A multi-branch repair network is considering how to triage service requests in its work involving a neighborhood repair cooperative. Some requests lack context, so staff currently ask clarifying questions. Who should own an expansion decision?
options: Expand only if evidence, safeguards, and readiness are adequate
A named business owner accountable for workflow outcomes
Use the simpler intervention if it meets the objective
Staff can review suggestions in the actual workflow
questions.correct_answer: A named business owner accountable for workflow outcomes
questions.rationale: A business owner can weigh evidence, costs, and responsibilities; model output does not create accountability. Apply this principle to business strategy and value hypotheses in the stated case; the scenario provides no basis to assume an unobserved outcome.

questions.prompt: A multi-branch repair network is considering how to triage service requests in its work involving a neighborhood repair cooperative. Some requests lack context, so staff currently ask clarifying questions. What strengthens a value claim?
options: Draft suggestions may reduce sorting effort if staff can verify them accurately
A documented current workflow and relevant outcome measures
A baseline comparison that includes review work and quality
The business outcome, affected user, and work to change
questions.correct_answer: A baseline comparison that includes review work and quality
questions.rationale: Useful evidence relates to the baseline and includes the work needed to use and check the system. Apply this principle to business strategy and value hypotheses in the stated case; the scenario provides no basis to assume an unobserved outcome.

questions.prompt: A multi-branch repair network is considering how to triage service requests in its work involving a neighborhood repair cooperative. Some requests lack context, so staff currently ask clarifying questions. A form redesign resolves the bottleneck. What is the sound response?
options: Compare AI assistance with process and conventional-tool alternatives
A bounded queue with staff checking suggestions and a review route
A named business owner accountable for workflow outcomes
Use the simpler intervention if it meets the objective
questions.correct_answer: Use the simpler intervention if it meets the objective
questions.rationale: The objective matters more than technology; an effective simpler intervention can be the better investment. Apply this principle to business strategy and value hypotheses in the stated case; the scenario provides no basis to assume an unobserved outcome.

questions.prompt: A multi-branch repair network is considering how to triage service requests in its work involving a neighborhood repair cooperative. Some requests lack context, so staff currently ask clarifying questions. Which assumption should be made visible?
options: Staff can review suggestions in the actual workflow
A baseline comparison that includes review work and quality
Use the simpler intervention if it meets the objective
Expand only if evidence, safeguards, and readiness are adequate
questions.correct_answer: Staff can review suggestions in the actual workflow
questions.rationale: An explicit assumption can be checked; silently assuming perfect output or cost-free oversight misleads. Apply this principle to business strategy and value hypotheses in the stated case; the scenario provides no basis to assume an unobserved outcome.

questions.prompt: A multi-branch repair network is considering how to triage service requests in its work involving a neighborhood repair cooperative. Some requests lack context, so staff currently ask clarifying questions. What is a defensible scale decision?
options: A documented current workflow and relevant outcome measures
Expand only if evidence, safeguards, and readiness are adequate
The business outcome, affected user, and work to change
Draft suggestions may reduce sorting effort if staff can verify them accurately
questions.correct_answer: Expand only if evidence, safeguards, and readiness are adequate
questions.rationale: Scale is a separate decision based on evidence and readiness; fluency and one test do not prove general suitability. Apply this principle to business strategy and value hypotheses in the stated case; the scenario provides no basis to assume an unobserved outcome.

questions.prompt: A finance federation is considering how to review parts quality notes in its work involving a food distributor. The service has several user groups and needs a correction and escalation route. Before reusing customer data for a new AI purpose, what must be established?

A justified retention period and secure deletion process
